newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures close sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures close sharply higher.

text.p: Feb 24 - U.S. stock index futures closed sharply higher, off highs. Traders said late shortcovering, buying encouraged by rise in NASDAQ stocks. Some cited technical buying above 802.00, plus big purchases by two investment banks, as behind morning's rise. Profittakers stepped in near close, limited advance. March S&P 500 futures volume estimated near 81,000. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
